title: Does Residual Muscular Weakness Lead to an Increase in Respiratory Complications in Bariatric Patients?
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if residual weakness after weight loss surgery leads to an increased risk of respiratory complications in the postoperative period.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- All patients scheduled for bariatric surgery at Flagler Hospital will be included after written and informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Patients will be excluded from the study if they don't consent to participate in the study. Patients allergic to any of the study medication will be excluded.
